checkin.label: Check in
checkin.title: Checking in a key
checkin.summary: Search the board by title, check the platform and region on each card, pick the edition, read the requirements and add the key to your cart.
captions: Search the board by title, platform or genre
Every card names its platform and region
Pick the edition and check the requirements
checkin.tipGate: Platform 1 · Steam · Global. Global means no regional lock.
checkin.tipRequirements: Needs a Steam account. Languages: EN, DE, FR, ES, PL. Delivered to your account.

pay.label: Pay
pay.title: Paying on the hosted page
pay.summary: Confirm the order and the delivery terms, enter your card details on the payment provider's hosted page, and your bank confirms the payment with 3-D Secure. Keyterminus receives the confirmation, never your card number.
pay.hostedUrl: secure payment page · your payment provider
captions: Confirm the order and the delivery terms
Card details go into the payment provider's hosted page
Your bank confirms it's you with 3-D Secure
We receive the confirmation, never your card number
pay.regionCheck: I've checked the platform and region of each key.
pay.terms: I have read and agree to the Terms and Conditions
pay.hostedNote: Illustration of a payment provider's hosted page. The real page belongs to the provider.
pay.bankWaiting: Approve this payment in your banking app
pay.bankNote: 3-D Secure check between you and your bank
pay.notReceived: Card number: stays with the payment provider
pay.tipConfirmation: Keyterminus receives: payment confirmed, amount, order number. The card number stays with the payment provider.

depart.label: Departs
depart.title: Your key departs
depart.summary: Once payment is confirmed your key is issued to your account. It waits on blank flaps until you reveal it, then you copy it or open the platform's redeem page.
captions: Payment confirmed: your key departs for your account
It waits on blank flaps until you reveal it
Copy it, or open the platform's redeem page
depart.tipBoard: Stored encrypted. Decrypted only when you choose Reveal.
depart.tipBoardPlain: Kept in your account. Shown only when you choose Reveal.
depart.tipRedeem: Opens Steam's own redeem page in a new tab
depart.heading: Keys

arrive.label: Arrives
arrive.title: Redeeming on the platform
arrive.summary: Redeeming happens on the platform itself: find its redeem screen, paste the key, confirm, and the game shows up in your library.
captions: The game arrives in your library
arrive.agree: I agree to the terms of the subscriber agreement
arrive.illustration: Neutral illustration of a launcher window. Menu names come from the platform's help pages.

help.label: Help desk
help.title: Getting help with a key
help.summary: A key that fails is reported from its order page. We look into it and answer {replyTime}; faulty keys get a replacement, or a refund when none is available.
captions: Key not working? Report it from the order
A faulty key is replaced, or refunded
help.dialogTitle: Report a key that doesn't work
help.note: Steam says this key was already used.
help.tipOutcome: Sample outcome. When a key fails and it isn’t down to you, you get a replacement, or a refund if there is none to send.
